title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt CI hooks and metrics upload
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add per-prompt CI hooks and automatic metrics upload so teams get prompt-level regression signals directly in PRs. This change wires the eval-harness per-prompt runner into our CI pipeline and uploads summarized metrics to the metrics ingestion service used by the console.

What this PR does: Implements a reusable CircleCI orb and a GitHub Actions step (kept behind a feature flag) that runs the eval-harness on a per-prompt basis for changed prompt sets. Adds a small shim in eval-harness to emit a compact JSON summary (perf/quality metrics per prompt) and a CLI flag to run only affected prompts. Integrates a secure upload path to metrics-ingest with retry/backoff and basic schema validation.

Key files: list below contains the main entry points and examples of the changes.

Testing: Unit tests for the new CLI flag and serializer, e2e integration test that exercises the CircleCI orb in a simulated environment, and a smoke workflow that uploads a sample payload to the staging ingestion endpoint. Local testing notes included in the README change.

Rollout plan: Feature gated by org setting eval_per_prompt_ci. Default remains off for orgs that have not opted in. Once enabled a subset of repos will see per-prompt gating in PR checks; we will monitor error rates and ingestion traffic for two weeks before enabling broadly.

Checklist:
- [x] Add CLI flag --changed-prompts and unit tests
- [x] Add JSON summary serializer and schema
- [x] Implement metrics upload client with retries
- [x] Add CircleCI orb + GH Actions step
- [x] Docs and README examples
- [x] E2E smoke test against staging ingest

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the uploader conservative (no PII, size cap 256KB per PR). Larger datasets will be stored in S3 and referenced by the summary payload. Related: ENG-4821 (per-prompt CI design), ENG-4999 (metrics schema v2).

review_comments: Ben Walker (reviewer): Can we make the default uploader endpoint configurable via env var? I want an easy kill-switch in-flight.
Aisha Patel (author): Yes - added EVAL_METRICS_INGEST_URL and a fallback to builtin staging endpoint. Documented in READMEs.
Kai Huang (reviewer): The schema looks good. Please add a version field and include a trimmed prompt_id to avoid large prompt text in PR metadata.
Aisha Patel (author): Added schema v2.version and prompt_id_hash (sha256 first 8 bytes) - prompt text is only included when size < 1KB.
Priya Desai (reviewer): Tests look solid. One nit: the orb should forward workspace envs explicitly to avoid surprises.
Aisha Patel (author): Fixed orb to forward required envs and added a comment explaining the rationale.
Ben Walker (approver): Approving - good to ship behind the feature flag. Leave monitoring alerts for ingestion error > 5%.
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hooks and metrics upload for eval-harness (feature-gated). Provides PR-level per-prompt regression checks and emits compact metrics summaries to the metrics ingestion service. Disabled by default; enable with eval_per_prompt_ci org setting.
